blocksidesound.config.title: BlocksideSound Settings
blocksidesound.config.defaults_confirm: Reset all BlocksideSound settings? Changes take effect only after saving.
blocksidesound.config.weather_hint: Rain sounds also follow Minecraft master and weather volume.
blocksidesound.config.enabled_help: Enable or disable all sounds added by this mod. Vanilla sounds are unaffected.
blocksidesound.config.volume_help: Volume of all sounds added by BlocksideSound.
blocksidesound.config.rain_enabled_help: Enable material rain sounds and plant drips. Vanilla rain stays audible.
blocksidesound.config.rain_volume_help: Volume multiplier for all material rain sounds and plant drips.
blocksidesound.config.materials_help: Adjust each material and plant drips independently.
blocksidesound.config.material_help: Open this material’s settings. Stone, ceramic and ground do not yet include audio; resource packs can supply it.
blocksidesound.config.plant_help: Occasional drips from plants. Independent of the foliage material switch.
blocksidesound.config.material_enabled_h: Enable enhancement for this material; vanilla rain remains.
blocksidesound.config.material_volume_he: Volume multiplier for this material only.
blocksidesound.config.probability_help: Chance per scheduled attempt. 100% still respects intervals and sound limits.
blocksidesound.config.interval_help: Time between attempts, not sound duration. Use arrow keys for precise adjustments. 20 ticks = 1 second.
blocksidesound.config.exclusions_help: Do not enhance matching blocks or existing tags. They keep their material and vanilla rain.
blocksidesound.config.max_sounds_help: Maximum simultaneous sounds from this mod. Higher values may sound busier.
blocksidesound.config.radius_help: Horizontal scan radius in blocks. Sounds still fade over 16 blocks; a larger scan does not increase audible range.
blocksidesound.config.vertical_help: Vertical distance from the camera in blocks for eligible rain surfaces.
blocksidesound.config.scan_interval_help: Ticks between surface scan batches. Lower values refresh faster but cost more work.
blocksidesound.config.scan_budget_help: Maximum loaded columns checked per scan batch. Affects refresh speed, not trigger probability.
blocksidesound.config.debug_logging_help: Write scan and playback details to the log. Disable for normal play.
blocksidesound.config.debug_particles_he: Show sampled surfaces using colored particles. Disable for normal play.
blocksidesound.config.overrides_help: Assign block IDs or existing tags to a material. IDs take priority over tags; within each type the first match wins.
blocksidesound.config.selector_help: Use namespace:block or #namespace:tag. Tags must already exist in the current world. Click Add Rule to include the typed entry.
blocksidesound.config.add_rule_help: Add the typed selector to this editing draft. Save & Return writes all changes.
blocksidesound.config.remove_rule_help: Click to remove this rule from the draft. Cancel discards changes.
blocksidesound.config.duplicate_rule: That block or tag already has a rule here.
blocksidesound.config.save_failed: Could not save settings. Your draft is kept; check the log and try again.
